card_text: Braids from Hobbs: text the photo first, clear the day, and make the hours in the chair worth the road.

seo.title: Braids for Men from Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Braids for men from Hobbs, done in Carlsbad west on US 62/180. Why the long appointment earns the drive, and how to learn the price before you leave.

blocks.h1: Braids, worth the drive from Hobbs.
paragraphs: Braids are the one appointment where the trip from Hobbs feels short. Booksy holds {{minutes:braids}} for a set, and the drive to my chair in Carlsbad is about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes, {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles west on {{city:hobbs.route}} (OpenStreetMap routing).
Every set is built for the person in the chair, over a fade if you want one, so the planning starts before you leave Lea County.

blocks.heading: Text the photo first.
paragraphs: Booksy lists braids with a price that varies by style. Send me a picture of the set you're after at {{phone}} before booking, so you know the price and I know what rows to plan. Doing that from Hobbs saves a drive that ends in a surprise.
Then pick a slot with nothing after it. The {{minutes:braids}} Booksy blocks plus the road back is most of a day.

items.title: Braids
items.body: Personalized braiding styles: rows straight back, pairs meeting at the crown, cuffs on the ends if you want them. Priced by the style after you text me a photo.

blocks.heading: Make the hours count.
paragraphs: The average commute in Hobbs is {{city:hobbs.commute_min}} minutes (Census ACS 2023). The drive here is more than three of those, one way. That's why it's worth asking, when you text, about a fade on the sides in the same visit: clean skin makes the rows stand out, and you're not back on 62/180 for a separate cut.

Hobbs gets about {{city:hobbs.days_100f}} days a year at 100°F or more (Open-Meteo, 2023–25), and some people like faded sides under the rows for that reason alone: less hair on the neck through the hot months.
Payment is after the braids are finished: cash, card, Zelle or Cash App. Cancel early on Booksy if plans change; a late cancellation on a booking this long may carry a cancellation fee.

items.q: How do I find out the price of braids before I drive over?
items.a: Text me a photo of the style at {{phone}}. Booksy only shows the price as varies.
Booksy reserves {{minutes:braids}}. Add about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes each way from Hobbs.

items.q: Can the fade be done in the same visit?
items.a: Ask when you text; most sets in my photos sit over a fade or a taper.
